description: Transcribe speech in a video or audio file to captions with Workers AI Whisper (large-v3-turbo); returns SRT, VTT or JSON with word timestamps (format). Paid: 1 credit per audio minute (1 credit = 1 cent); a short balance gets 402 insufficient_balance (requiredCents, balanceCents, checkoutUrl) and no job starts. Use it when you only need the text or want to edit it before burning (then edit_transcript -> burn_captions). For burned-in subtitles in one call use caption_video; for highlights use create_clips. Audio is extracted to 16 kHz mono (video frames are not decoded). Language defaults to auto-detect; the saved glossary is applied. Results are cached per key, language, format and duration; another key cannot read them.

api_key.description: Only for a connection without an Authorization header: the token create_key returned (av_live_...). Pass it on every call to use that key in this same session, no reconnect or config change. Ignored when the connection already sends a key. It works like a password: create a new key if this conversation is shared.

durationSeconds.description: Optional duration hint used before probe.

fileId.description: Id from upload {action:'start'}, upload {action:'inline'}, or POST /v1/uploads.

glossary.description: Names and terms. Used as the Whisper prompt and to fix close spellings. Included in the transcription price.

language.description: BCP-47 language, or omit for auto.

maxCredits.description: Refuse the job when the debit would exceed this many cents.

mediaUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the audio or video file.

notifyEmail.description: Optional completion email. Free. Needs the email binding.

useSavedGlossary.description: Default true: also apply the saved glossary (update_glossary {action:'save'}) with its alias fixes, e.g. 'awesome video' -> 'AwesomeVideo'. Free.

webhookUrl.description: Public https URL. POSTed an HMAC-signed JSON body when the job finishes. Three tries.

name: transcribe

outputSchema.description: A job: poll get_job with id until status is succeeded or failed.

error.description: Failure reason when status is failed.

expiresAt.description: When the result files are deleted.

id.description: Job id: pass it to get_job, resume_job, edit_transcript or as transcriptionJobId.

kind.description: Job kind (transcribe, burn, caption, clips, shorts, trim, dub, translate, preview, metadata...).

result.description: Result when succeeded: url, files[{name, url}], clips, text...

title: Transcribe
